displayName: OCI-WSTG01-017: User Enumeration via Login Error Messages
description:
Detects login error messages that differentiate between invalid username and invalid password

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

conditions.value: user enumeration via login error messages

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_wstg01_017", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%enumeration%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%login%') AND "value" > 0
